requirement.description: The receive_messages method in SubprocessCLITransport returns a coroutine instead of an async iterator, causing 'async for' to fail with 'requires an object with __aiter__ method, got coroutine' error.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages method must return an async iterator (AsyncIterator[dict[str, Any]]) that can be consumed with 'async for' syntax. The method should properly yield messages from the transport's output stream.

requirement.description: The __aexit__ method in ClaudeSDKClient doesn't properly close the transport when exiting the async context manager, leading to connection leaks and 'Expected 'close' to have been called once' assertion errors.
requirement.contract: The __aexit__ method must ensure that disconnect() is called on the transport when exiting the async context manager, and that any exceptions during disconnect are suppressed to avoid masking the original exception.

requirement.description: The InternalClient.process_query method doesn't properly handle closing stdin after sending prompts in streaming mode, causing connection issues for one-shot queries.
requirement.contract: The process_query method must ensure that stdin is properly closed after sending all messages when using close_stdin_after_prompt=True, to prevent hanging connections.

requirement.description: Missing proper error handling in _stream_to_stdin method which can cause connection issues when handling async streams.
requirement.contract: The _stream_to_stdin method must properly handle exceptions during streaming and ensure cleanup of resources, including proper closing of stdin streams.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of the close_stdin_after_prompt parameter in SubprocessCLITransport constructor leads to improper stream closure in one-shot query mode.
requirement.contract: The SubprocessCLITransport constructor must correctly handle the close_stdin_after_prompt parameter to ensure stdin is closed appropriately after sending all messages in one-shot mode.
